g.text: time over the instances some system answers: a run that does not answer (out of time or memory, failed, or a

g.text: program the system cannot express) counts as its time limit (300 or 600 s), a time under 0.2 s as 0.2 s. Beside

g.text: it, the same over the instances both answer.
